description: A Flutter widget implementing a mini video player that appears at the bottom of the app, providing minimal inline controls and the ability to expand to full view.

classes.name: MiniPlayer
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a dockable mini video player with inline controls.

classes.name: _MiniBarSkeleton
classes.description: A private widget showing a loading skeleton with a close button while the video is initializing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MiniPlayer widget tree, primarily a Consumer that reacts to VideoPlayerProvider state.

methods.name: _progress
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current progress of the video playback as a fraction between 0 and 1.
